text:
maria: kicking off deploy for service-model-router. plan: feature flag 'model-v2' ramp 5% -> 20% -> 50% in 30m windows. pinging @ben for canary checks and @sophia for infra watch.
ben: ack, watching errors + latency. will call hold if error > 1% or p99 jumps.
deploy-bot: deployment started for service-model-router @ commit abc123def (maria)
deploy-bot: canary rollout: model-v2 = 5% globally
sophia: seeing a small p99 spike in eu-west-1 embed workers, investigating logs
ben: same, a single host shows kernel OOMs and high swap. draining it now.
maria: holding ramp. suggestion: revert flag in eu-west-1 only until infra fixed.
sophia: I can reprovision the node and redeploy kernel config. recommend pausing ff in eu-west-1 rather than full rollback.
ben: agree. scoped toggle please.
maria: running admin command: `/ff toggle model-v2 false --scope=eu-west-1 --by=maria`
deploy-bot: feature flag updated: model-v2 = false (scope: eu-west-1) by maria
sophia: latency/p99 back to baseline in eu-west-1 after drain, looks stable now
ben: infra fix queued, will confirm node healthy then we can resume with a smaller canary (2%) for 15m
maria: noted. scheduling resumed ramp window in ~25m; release notes updated with incident and rollback rationale: https://wiki.redwood/inference/releases/172350 (private)
ben: please include the metric snapshot and the exact flag command in the notes. helps audits.
maria: added: "Scoping command used and timeline; reason: kernel OOM on one host caused p99 spike; paused ramp; resumed after drain"
sophia: :thumbsup: nice quick scope toggle, saved a full rollback
deploy-bot: deployment status: partial canary paused, manual resume required
maria: will start 2% canary after infra green. tagging @oncall in case of regressions.
ben: thanks all. follow-up: create a short playbook step for scoped flag toggles (so PMs know what to expect on partial rollbacks).
maria: agreed—I'll draft a short playbook and post in #eng-releases later today.
